meta.coverage: Table 40: Minutes per participant in paid and unpaid activities, by place, main activity of each half-hour · minutes
meta.sourceTitle: Table (40): Minutes in a day spent on an average per participant of age 6 years and above in different unpaid and paid activities where the activity was a major activity (considering only the major activity of the time slots) by place of activity
meta.note: January–December 2024 survey, age 6 and above unless the source header names another universe. Snapshot axis is an annual anchor, not an observation on 1 January. All-activities time is equally allocated across recorded activities within each slot; major-only time assigns the whole slot to its major activity. Source dashes are catalogued as unavailable and never changed to zero. Source revision date beyond this report edition is not supplied.
